Configure current feature

  1. Add Rillmere water fish pool and safe pier, BP_FishingBobber and matching fishing UI. Source p3/rod clips remain audit-gated; use visibly labeled debug presentation.
  2. Configure maxcast1200cm, serverwait3–8seconds, reactionwindow1.5seconds and weighted species. One active attempt per character; fish/profession reward commit terminal.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. Equip rod, aim at suitable water and cast. Server validates shore/player/volume and creates one bobber/attempt; B sees only public fishing presentation.
  2. Wait for the server bite state and reel within the accepted time window. Resolve one fish and5fishingXP via durable attempt receipt.
  3. Replay reel and a delayed animation notify after success; disconnect/rejoin and verify the same inventory result.
  4. Crash/restart before bite and immediately after committed success.
Expected success
Unresolved interrupted attempts cancel without catch; committed catches survive. One attempt has one terminal outcome.
Bobber uses3Dworld coordinates; shoreline and range constraints are independent of cosmetic rod pose.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Weather/time modifiers exist as controlled optional data but stay disabled until17. No fabricated swim/casting sheet frames.

current-phase fixtureFor full bag, this fixture terminates failed with no fish/XP; do not silently grant after reconnect.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

One fishing attempt has one terminal outcome; replay/notify/restart cannot add catches.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
